verdict.rationale: Clara's marketing claims real-time insights on all company spend through Clara Intelligence. Its transactions API docs list near-real-time monitoring and analysis by user, team, or category, and transaction webhooks push events as they happen. However, the team and category breakdowns are framed as dashboards a developer builds on the API, not a documented built-in founder view. Missing for 10: a documented first-party dashboard breaking spend down by team, category and merchant; any evidence of a merchant-level breakdown; independent or hands-on confirmation of same-day visibility.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see company spend in real time — by team, category, and merchant — the day it happens, not when statements land

citations.quote: Clara Intelligence™ Real-time insights that centralize and analyze all company spend
Analyze spend by user, team, or category; Monitor transaction activity in near real-time
You register a subscription — a callback URL, the transaction statuses you care about, and a signing secret — and Clara POSTs the event to your URL, signed with HMAC-SHA256.
